caseName: Graham v. Ill. Dep't of Juvenile Justice
caseNameFull: Shawnetta T. GRAHAM v. ILLINOIS DEPARTMENT OF JUVENILE JUSTICE

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until October 28, 2013, within which *383to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
